**Migrated 11 files from `db.query` to `db.execute({ sql, params })`.**

Touched files: `macroAdmin.js`, `sla.js`, `cohort.js`, `teamService.js`, `apiKeyAdmin.js`, `shipment.js`, `couponService.js`, `session.js`, `returnService.js`, `variantAdmin.js`, `supplier.js`, `refund.js`.

Left [vendor/legacy-orm/adapter.js](vendor/legacy-orm/adapter.js:9) alone. Its header says it's a vendored copy, overwritten wholesale on every upgrade, do not edit.

All `cache.query` calls are a separate cache API, untouched. No `db.query` left outside vendor.
